distance: cumulative Euclidean distance between recorded ego positions
within_scenario: time-weighted speed within each spatial bin; standstill included
across_scenarios: equal weight per available scenario mean within each framework and spatial bin
limit_meaning: configured route-section reference, logged as road_speed_limit_mps
outliers: type-7 linear quartiles within framework and spatial bin; below Q1 - 1.5 IQR or above Q3 + 1.5 IQR
missingness: unvisited bins are not imputed; scenario_count gives the denominator
